DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GrassGolem:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, Dualith increases it's and the player's Attack and Defense stat by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>, reduces own active skill cooldowns by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue3}%</>, and can fire a powerful Grass laser from its right hand.
